description:
## Scope

In pkix-difftest/src/oracles/pkix_path.rs, when Chain.crls is non-empty, construct a pkix-revocation::CrlChecker and pass it to validate_path.

## What

- When chain.crls.is_empty(): existing behavior (no revocation).
- When chain.crls has 1+ DER blobs: construct CrlChecker. If multiple CRLs, future work — start with single-CRL support.
- Single-CRL: CrlChecker::new(crls[0], now_unix, verifier). Hand the checker to a wrapper that ties revocation check into chain walk.

The current pkix-path validate_path API does not directly accept a RevocationChecker (that's pkix-chain's role). The harness wires this by calling validate_path then, on Ok, iterating the chain and calling checker.check_revocation pairwise. Or — preferred — uses pkix-chain::verify_chain in 'revocation enabled' mode.

## Acceptance

- [ ] pkix-path oracle accepts Chain.crls and routes revocation through pkix-revocation when non-empty.
- [ ] Empty crls path unchanged.
- [ ] One test with a known-revoked PKITS leaf and the relevant CRL — verdict is Fail with reason mentioning 'revoked'.

## Depends on

PKIX-emf1.1 (Chain.crls field must exist first).

## Parent

PKIX-emf1.
title: Wire pkix-path oracle to use CrlChecker when Chain.crls is non-empty
